description.html: HabiStat Repton is an advanced vitamin, mineral and amino acid supplement specially designed for insect-eating reptiles. Its ultra-fine formula coats insects evenly when dusting, guaranteeing that your animals get a consistent dose of nutrients with every meal. Repton contains vitamin A, the complete B-complex, vitamins C, D3, E and K3, as well as a wide range of minerals and essential amino acids.

The amino acids in Repton are especially important because they are the building blocks of the proteins reptiles need for growth, tissue repair and maintaining muscle mass. This combination of vitamins, minerals and amino acids makes Repton one of the most complete supplements on the market for insect-eating species. The recommended dosing is to dust insects at every eighth feeding, which provides adequate nutritional support without the risk of hypervitaminosis.

This product comes in a practical 40g pouch that suits owners with a small number of animals. For those with a larger reptile collection, HabiStat Repton is also available in a 100g jar that offers better value. Repton is ideal for leopard geckos, bearded dragons, chameleons and all other species that feed mainly on insects.
